purpose: Teach: セクシー/グッド/軍団/不気味/嗜好/バリバリ/アイスランド/死な

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、雑誌のモデル、セクシーな雰囲気ね
lines.en: Sho, that magazine model had quite a striking presence, didn't he?
lines.style: Soft, musing tone. Speaking more to herself than to him. Gentle curiosity in her voice, the kind of observation a mother makes aloud. Warm but distant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、図画工作で「グッド」評価もらったよ
lines.en: Mom, I got a 'good' mark on my art project.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Simple statement, almost matter-of-fact, but there's a small lift at the end. Genuinely pleased but not performing it. The confidence of a small boy sharing something real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお気に入りアニメ、ヒーロー軍団なのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know your father really does love that hero anime, don't you?
lines.style: Reflective, talking more to the thought than to him. Noticing a connection between them. Warm observation. Slight pause before speaking, like she's remembering something fond.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お風呂場で不気味な音、聞こえたよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard a strange noise in the bathroom.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Quiet concern underneath, but stated plainly without dramatizing. The seriousness of something small. A pause, like he's waiting to see if she heard it too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの食の嗜好、覚えてね
lines.en: Sho, try to remember what your grandmother likes to eat, all right?
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not commanding. A moment of tenderness in the domestic detail. She's teaching him something about care. Warm but practical.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノ、バリバリ練習してるよ
lines.en: Mom, I've been practicing piano really hard.
lines.style: Earnest announcement. Small boy proud of his effort. Energy under the words, but restrained—not shouting about it, just wanting her to know. Honest and direct.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、アイスランドはオーロラが見える国らしいわ
lines.en: Sho, Iceland is a place where you can see the northern lights.
lines.style: Distant, wonderstruck tone. Speaking as if imagining it herself. Sharing something beautiful she just learned. Soft, unhurried pacing. The voice of someone giving a gift of knowledge.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに「死なないで」って手紙書いたの
lines.en: Mom, I wrote a letter to Grandpa telling him not to die.
lines.style: Quiet, vulnerable. The words come simply but with weight. No performance, no self-consciousness. A child's honest heart. Slight tremor of need underneath the calm delivery.
